query: I have a 43‑year‑old woman. Among female inpatients aged 38–48 with AMI, calculate a 72‑hour lab instability score, stratify AMI patients into quartiles, and report LOS and in‑hospital mortality for each quartile. Compare overall critical‑lab rates to age‑matched controls.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, d.diagnosis, s.stay_length_of_stay, l.lab_event_id, l.value, l.value_uom, l.ref_range_lower, l.ref_range_upper, l.flag, l.priority, l.comments, (l.value - l.ref_range_lower) / NULLIF(l.ref_range_upper - l.ref_range_lower, 0) AS instability_score, (l.value_uom = 'g/dL') AS is_glucose, (l.flag = 'H') AS is_high, (l.priority = 'C') AS is_critical, (l.comments = 'Suspicious') AS is_suspicious, (l.value_uom = 'g/dL' AND l.flag = 'H' AND l.priority = 'C' AND l.comments = 'Suspicious') AS is_critical_glucose_high_suspicious FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN icustays s ON a.subject_id = s.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.subject_id = l.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.age BETWEEN 38 AND 48 AND d.diagnosis = 'AMI' AND s.stay_length_of_stay >= 72 AND l.value_uom = 'g/dL' AND l.flag = 'H' AND l.priority = 'C' AND l.comments = 'Suspicious' ORDER BY instability_score NULLS LAST;
